name: Brand board (social)
description: Your brand kit as one card: the logo on light and on dark, the colours with their hex codes and the type, all from the brand kit. Nothing to write: share it with anyone who makes things for you.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

logo_label.label: Logo heading
logo_label.description: The heading over the logo on light and on dark.

on_light_label.label: On light
on_light_label.description: The caption under the logo on the brand's paper.

on_dark_label.label: On dark
on_dark_label.description: The caption under the logo on the dark stage.

colour_label.label: Colour heading
colour_label.description: The heading over the colour swatches.

primary_label.label: Primary

secondary_label.label: Secondary

accent_label.label: Accent
accent_label.description: The name of the accent colour's swatch.

paper_label.label: Paper

text_label.label: Text
text_label.description: The name of the text colour's swatch.

dark_label.label: Dark
